_comment: Phase cards printed by scripts/next.mjs. Each card carries the rules that phase must obey INLINE, so lazy loading never hides a rule. `read` is just-in-time and scoped (a section, not a file); `invoke` says how to use a skill: digest (already in .beyond-ui/SKILL.md, do not invoke), full (Skill tool, counts toward the budget of 4), head (read only the first N lines), or tool (run its script/command only).

neverRead: any *-design studio skill beyond its first 150 lines

phases.title: BOOTSTRAP
phases.goal: A project to build in, a run state, the 10 routed skills and the tool layer.
run: Empty repo? Scaffold the platform's default stack first (PLATFORMS.md table, or: web `npx create-next-app@latest . --ts --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir --import-alias "@/*" --use-npm && npx shadcn@latest init -d && npm i motion gsap lenis`; mobile `npx create-expo-app@latest .`).
node <skill>/scripts/bootstrap-upstream-skills.mjs   (skills + Playwright, Scrapling + browsers, browser-use; skip-if-present)
rules: Never ask the user what the UI should look like; the idea is enough.
A skill that fails to install: fetch its raw SKILL.md URL, read only what the digest needs, record it in state.skills.missing.

phases.title: BRIEF
phases.goal: Turn the idea into screens, sections and the domain content an expert expects.
run: node <skill>/scripts/sources.mjs brief "<the user's idea, verbatim>" [--platform web|mobile|desktop]
Complete every TODO in .beyond-ui/brief.md (web-search the category's leaders for content expectations).
rules: Domain content inventory is a checklist the build must satisfy (ML dashboard: accuracy/precision/recall/F1, loss curves, confusion matrix, parameters, hyperparameters, runs, datasets, latency).
Screens before sections: list every page/screen with its primary action.
Theme only if the user or brand states it; otherwise the anchor decides later. No default theme.
Ask only for what would be wrong to invent: real customers, real numbers, brand assets.

read.when: the first time in a session

phases.title: RECON
phases.goal: Know the platform, framework and existing design system.
rules: An existing brand or design system wins over any reference.
Pick the stack from PLATFORMS.md §'Choosing the platform' when the repo has none.

read.section: §'The stack per platform' row for this platform only

invoke.when: only when redesigning an existing UI

phases.title: SOURCE
phases.goal: Real references, templates and components on disk, and the images actually looked at.
run: node <skill>/scripts/sources.mjs fetch      (Scrapling; takes 10-15 min; run in the background if the harness allows)
Open every image under .beyond-ui/refs/references and .beyond-ui/refs/templates (multimodal Read). Then: node <skill>/scripts/sources.mjs viewed <the files you opened>
Write .beyond-ui/scout.md: 4+ source URLs with what you took from each, and a library map with install commands.
rules: Never wait for the user to name sites; the catalogs exist for that.
Judge images for THIS product's surface and audience: a dashboard idea needs dashboard references, a mobile app needs app screens.
If a gallery is bot-walled, web-search site:<gallery> <category> and fetch the winners directly (Scrapling MCP tools).
Do not read .beyond-ui/sources/*.md wholesale; grep them for links if needed.

invoke.when: a gallery needs scrolling/filters that fetch cannot do

phases.done: fetch-log.json okCount>=8 across >=4 categories, >=8 images viewed, scout.md has 4+ URLs and an install command

phases.title: SELECT
phases.goal: One anchor reference that will supply 85% of the design, plus 4 supporting references.
run: Write .beyond-ui/references-selection.json: exactly 5 selected, one with "anchor": true, each with url, why, award/curation note.
rules: The anchor is the reference closest to this product's surface and audience with the most complete system, not the flashiest.
At least one supporting reference should be a live product site (computed CSS and motion truth).
A matching studio *-design skill: read its first 150 lines only (tokens, type, palette), cite it.
phases.done: references-selection.json has 5 entries and exactly one anchor

phases.title: TEARDOWN
phases.goal: Measured design systems for the references and a section plan.
run: Image anchors (Dribbble/Behance/Mobbin): write .beyond-ui/teardown/<slug>/image-analysis.md — grid, spacing steps, radius, borders/shadows, type classification and scale, OKLCH palette, components, density.
rules: Teardown tokens of a gallery host are the gallery's, not the design's; measure the image instead.
If teardown.mjs fails, read TEARDOWN.md §'TEARDOWN — run it' only.

phases.title: DIGEST
phases.goal: One condensed project skill holding the 10 routed skills' rules and the build sheet.
run: Read .beyond-ui/SKILL.md once, fully. It replaces invoking the 5 permanent skills.
rules: Do NOT invoke frontend-design, ui-ux-pro-max, taste, impeccable or frontend-ui-engineering in full: their rules are in the digest. Invoke one only to use its tool (ui-ux-pro-max search, impeccable detectors).

phases.title: DIRECTION
phases.goal: The anchor mapped section by section, the type chosen from a specimen, the direction contract written.
run: node <skill>/scripts/fidelity.mjs init  -> fill .beyond-ui/fidelity.json (source, evidence file, adapted, per section; source per system aspect)
node <skill>/scripts/fonts.mjs search && node <skill>/scripts/fonts.mjs specimen  -> open every specimen-*.png
Write the direction contract in scout.md: Design Read, type, OKLCH colours (neutral ramp, one accent, one signal), spacing, radius, motion tokens (MICRO.md table), non-goals, evidence per field.
rules: 85% from references: layout, spacing rhythm, component styling, type scale, motion grammar. 15% own: content, domain sections, theme. Never copy copy, logos, imagery, proprietary fonts.
Type matches the anchor's classification; app titles use the text family at weight, not a display face; mono only for code/data; no ALL-CAPS mono labels.
Apple HIG as the tie-breaker: hierarchy (content first, controls recede), harmony (concentric radii, consistent spacing), consistency (platform conventions).
One accent colour; tinted neutrals (never pure #000/#fff); contrast ≥ 4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text and UI.

invoke.when: search its database for the product type's pattern

phases.title: COMPOSE
phases.goal: Every control and section imported, not hand-written.
run: Install the base kit items and the planned registry blocks (exact commands in .beyond-ui/BLOCK-MAP.md).
Sections the anchor lacks: node <skill>/scripts/harvest.mjs page <template-url> --pick <roles>  (look at the PNGs), rebuild in the anchor's system.
rules: Base kit first (shadcn/ui on React web; RN Reusables on Expo; see PLATFORMS.md), registries second (2-3 in play), custom last with `beyond-ui:custom <reason>`.
Restyle imported components through tokens; an unthemed shadcn default is itself an AI tell.
Never paste a template's copy; harvested HTML is structure only.

read.when: only if BLOCK-MAP.md lacks a command you need

phases.title: BUILD
phases.goal: An experience, not a screenshot: real content, full domain inventory, real states, micro-interactions on every component, transitions between every page.
run: Build section by section from fidelity.json; after each section, render it and compare with its evidence image.
Wire motion with the MICRO.md tokens: every interactive component gets hover/press/focus feedback; overlays enter and exit; lists animate; numbers roll; charts draw in; routes transition.
rules: Every interactive element answers within one frame: hover/press/focus states, 120-320ms, exits shorter than enters, no transition: all, no bounce on chrome.
Every page/screen change has a transition (View Transitions / AnimatePresence on web, native stack + shared element on mobile); the shell never animates.
Loading is a skeleton in the final layout; empty has a next action; error has recovery.
Marketing pages: GSAP + ScrollTrigger + Lenis + registry effects + CRAFT R1/R2/R6/R8. App UI: purposeful motion only. Native: platform springs and haptics.
Every domain inventory item from brief.md is on screen.
Responsive by construction (390/768/1440) on web; safe areas, 44pt/48dp targets, dynamic type on mobile.
Reduced motion swaps movement for opacity everywhere.

read.section: §'Per component' rows for components you are building + §'Page and screen transitions' row for this platform
only the recipe(s) the direction picked (R1-R9)

invoke.skill: gsap-skills or animejs-skills or the platform skill (vercel-react-native-skills, flutter-expert, swift-expert, kotlin-specialist)
invoke.when: the motion engine or platform needs it (budget 2 of 4)

phases.done: the app renders every screen with real content (move on to QA)

phases.title: QA
phases.goal: Used like a human on a phone and a desktop.
run: Native without web preview: screenshots on 2 device sizes + flow test into .beyond-ui/native-evidence.json (PLATFORMS.md §'Gates on non-web platforms').
rules: Keyboard-complete, visible focus, no console errors, reduced motion passes.
Fix what the journey finds, then rerun.

invoke.when: a flow needs scripting beyond qa.mjs

phases.done: a .beyond-ui/qa/*.json report passes keyboard, reduced motion and console

phases.title: CRITIQUE
phases.goal: Measured and judged against the anchor; overhaul if it is not at the anchor's level.
run: Screenshot each section next to its evidence image; score the 12 gates in CRITIQUE.md Part 2 into state.critique.
rules: Hard fails first (gradient text, pure black/white, emoji icons, transition: all, invisible focus, contrast < 4.5:1, sub-24px targets, horizontal scroll at 320px).
Any gate < 3, or the build visibly below the anchor: full overhaul from phase 1, not patches.
Fix, re-render, re-run until critique and motion-audit pass.

phases.title: FREEZE
phases.goal: Lock the signed-off design before any later pass.
run: Production build (next build && next start -p 3100, or the platform's preview).
rules: Later passes may not change the look; an intended change is re-baselined with --reason.

phases.title: HARDEN
phases.goal: States, craft, fidelity and parity all green without flattening the design.
rules: Remove cost, not design: cheaper, deferred, or device-scoped before removed.
A11y fixes change tokens or markup, never the look.

read.when: a fix would change the look

phases.done: states-audit, craft-audit, fidelity-report and parity-report all pass

phases.title: SHIP
phases.goal: Production-ready: metadata, share images, crawl surface, headers, 404, smoke tests (or the store checklist).
rules: Per-page canonical + unique title/description + OG image; one h1; real 404; security headers.
Deploying or submitting is the user's call.

invoke.when: the project will be deployed (budget 4 of 4)

phases.done: production-audit.json pass (or store-checklist.json pass, or surface is a component)

phases.title: GATE
rules: A failing gate is fixed by doing the work. Report what passed, what was accepted as risk, and the screenshots.
